# Deepline Operations

> AI operations consultancy for small and growing businesses: operator first, AI second. Anyone can buy an AI subscription or make a new hire; neither fixes broken processes, and tools without a system become shelfware. Deepline Operations learns the business top-down, maps its processes and SOPs, designs the highest-impact system with guardrails, then builds and integrates the infrastructure (connected email, CRM, QuickBooks/Xero and ops tools, plus AI employees trained on the company's SOPs), which the client owns long-term. Jersey City, NJ.

## Process
0. Free AI Ops Teardown: a free 30-minute call where we map one workflow live; the client leaves with a one-page plan showing what to automate first and its estimated return. It leads into the paid AI Ops Audit.
1. Diagnose: the paid AI Ops Audit. Learn the business top-down: workflows, processes, SOPs (47 questions across sales, marketing and back office)
2. Design: the ideal system, highest-impact priorities first, guardrails on anything touching customers or money, fixed scope
3. Build & integrate: connect the systems, deploy AI employees trained on the client's SOPs (drafts-only where it matters)
4. Hand over & train: the team is trained hands-on; the client owns every login, file and pipeline

## Pricing model
- One setup fee, plus whatever the ongoing software costs. No retainer. Prices are given after the Diagnose call (the only public price is the NJ AI Setup Day).
- Every engagement is scoped to return 10-30x the setup fee. This is a target, not a guarantee; results vary by business.

## Who's behind it
- Mo (Mohammedali) Roowala, CEO of Deepline Operations. Also CEO of RMI Direct and runs an e-commerce growth agency. M.S. in Robotics, NYU Tandon.
- Background: building e-commerce brands, lead generation for companies, investor outreach pipelines, backend ops and revenue dashboards, and running SEO writers. Example: went into AbuvThePar (a $50M+ Amazon operator) and integrated Ivy for outreach, purchasing and invoicing.

## Outcomes
- Grow revenue without growing payroll (2-3x volume, same team)
- Stop leaking money already earned: billing errors, price drift, missed reorders, unpaid invoices
- Turn existing customers into revenue with win-back, reorder and upsell campaigns (no new ad spend)
- Get the business out of the owner's head: SOPs codified into the AI employee
- Decisions on live numbers, not gut feel
- Never drop a lead or follow-up; onboard new hires in days; same-day quotes, proposals and campaigns

## Services (custom-scoped after the Diagnose step; one setup fee plus software costs)
1. AI Ops Audit: a 47-question audit of sales, marketing and back-office operations, with a ranked build plan
2. Back-office autopilot: inbox, orders and requests turned into structured work; invoice creation and QuickBooks/Xero reconciliation
3. CEO inbox and EA system: triage and drafted replies (drafts only; never auto-sends)
4. Revenue from existing customers: segmentation, win-back and reorder campaigns, analytics
5. Content and editing pipelines: SEO articles, backlinks, ads, decks and briefs checked against brand rules
6. Team AI setup and training: Grok Bot or Claude Cowork with custom skills, for small firms such as real estate and property management teams
7. Custom software for home services and contractors: estimating and quote tools with margin checks, customer portals, QuickBooks sync

## Proof
- Ivy (AbuvThePar, built for a $50M+ Amazon operator): weekly outreach 400 -> 1,050, calls 30 -> 250, purchase orders 6 -> 25-35, same team (no headcount added)
- Bean2Bean Coffee Co.: Gmail order intake, learn-from-edits review dashboard, client portal, QuickBooks sync. 466 order-related emails processed in 30 days, 82 portal accounts, 35 price-book fixes (~$1.8K/yr underbilling recovered)
- KO Alliance: sponsorship operations (decks, contracts, lead lists, VSLs, partnership-plan generator); the Plantiva sponsorship deal closed
- NutraChurn: automated SEO article and backlink pipeline, static ads pipeline, weekly reporting

## Free resource
- AI Ops Scorecard (https://deeplineop.ai/scorecard.html): 10 questions, about 3 minutes. Returns a score out of 100 with 4 sub-scores (Process & SOPs, Systems & data, Automation, Team leverage), the top 3 leaks with the fix we would build, the annual cost of manual work, and a 90-day roadmap. Calculated in the browser by a rules engine; no AI model reads the answers.
